name: Map Maker
description: Design custom fantasy transit diagrams, city layouts, and home plans with an octilinear schematic editor.
details:
Map Maker lets you design schematic fantasy transit maps, urban city blueprints, and home floorplans.

The Transit Map designer provides an authentic octilinear diagram canvas with grid-snapping, multiple colored routes, transfers and termini, airport markers, and curved waterways. Create custom metro systems for fictional worlds, tabletop campaigns, or transit enthusiasts.
